import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test'

const sizes = [
  { name: 'desktop', width: 1280, height: 900 },
  { name: 'mobile', width: 375, height: 800 },
]

async function goTo(page: Page, label: string) {
  const target = Date.parse('1 ' + label)
  const label$ = page.getByTestId('month-label')
  for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) {
    const cur = await label$.innerText()
    if (cur === label) return
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: Date.parse('1 ' + cur) > target ? 'Previous month' : 'Next month' }).click()
  }
  throw new Error('could not reach ' + label)
}

async function add(page: Page, o: { type?: 'income' | 'expense'; amount: string; cat?: string; date: string; note: string; repeat?: boolean }) {
  const form = page.getByRole('form', { name: 'Add transaction' })
  if (o.type) await form.getByText(o.type, { exact: true }).click()
  await form.getByLabel('Amount').fill(o.amount)
  if (o.cat) await form.getByLabel('Category').selectOption({ label: o.cat })
  await form.getByLabel('Date').fill(o.date)
  await form.getByLabel(/Note/).fill(o.note)
  if (o.repeat) await form.getByLabel('Repeat monthly').check()
  await form.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add transaction' }).click()
}

const row = (page: Page, text: string) => page.getByTestId('tx-row').filter({ hasText: text })

for (const s of sizes) {
  test.describe(s.name, () => {
    test.use({ viewport: { width: s.width, height: s.height } })

    test('recurring walkthrough', async ({ page }) => {
      const errors: string[] = []
      page.on('pageerror', (e) => errors.push(e.message))
      const overflow = () => page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth > document.documentElement.clientWidth)
      await page.goto('/')
      await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.clear())
      await page.reload()

      // Not repeating by default; a plain transaction never appears later
      await expect(page.getByRole('form', { name: 'Add transaction' }).getByLabel('Repeat monthly')).not.toBeChecked()
      await add(page, { amount: '5', cat: 'Fun', date: '2026-01-02', note: 'One-off' })
      await add(page, { amount: '100', cat: 'Housing', date: '2026-01-31', note: 'Rent', repeat: true })
      await expect(page.getByTestId('month-label')).toHaveText('January 2026')
      await expect(row(page, 'Rent')).toContainText('2026-01-31')
      await expect(row(page, 'Rent').getByTestId('recurring-badge')).toBeVisible()
      await expect(row(page, 'One-off').getByTestId('recurring-badge')).toHaveCount(0)

      // Appears in later months on the same day, clamped to the last day
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Next month' }).click()
      await expect(page.getByTestId('month-label')).toHaveText('February 2026')
      await expect(page.getByTestId('tx-row')).toHaveCount(1)
      await expect(row(page, 'Rent')).toContainText('2026-02-28')
      await expect(page.getByTestId('total-expenses')).toHaveText('$100.00')
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Next month' }).click()
      await expect(row(page, 'Rent')).toContainText('2026-03-31')
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Next month' }).click()
      await expect(row(page, 'Rent')).toContainText('2026-04-30')

      // No duplicates when reopening a month (switching back and forth, and after a reload)
      for (const m of ['February 2026', 'April 2026', 'February 2026']) {
        await goTo(page, m)
        await expect(page.getByTestId('tx-row')).toHaveCount(1)
      }
      await page.reload()
      await goTo(page, 'February 2026')
      await expect(page.getByTestId('tx-row')).toHaveCount(1)
      await goTo(page, 'January 2026')
      await expect(page.getByTestId('tx-row')).toHaveCount(2)
      await expect(page.getByTestId('total-expenses')).toHaveText('$105.00')

      // Leap year: 31st -> 29th (income repeats as income)
      await add(page, { type: 'income', amount: '50', cat: 'Other', date: '2028-01-31', note: 'Side gig', repeat: true })
      await goTo(page, 'February 2028')
      await expect(row(page, 'Side gig')).toContainText('2028-02-29')
      await expect(page.getByTestId('total-income')).toHaveText('$50.00')
      await goTo(page, 'February 2027')
      await expect(row(page, 'Rent')).toContainText('2027-02-28')

      // Edit a repeating transaction: checkbox is ticked; later months follow, earlier ones don't change
      await goTo(page, 'February 2026')
      await row(page, 'Rent').getByRole('button', { name: 'Edit transaction' }).click()
      const edit = page.getByRole('form', { name: 'Edit transaction' })

      await expect(rent.getByRole('button', { name: 'Stop repeating…' })).toHaveCount(0)
      await expect(page.getByTestId('rule-row').filter({ hasText: 'Side gig' }).getByTestId('rule-status')).toHaveText('Active')

import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test'

const sizes = [
  { name: 'desktop', width: 1280, height: 900 },
  { name: 'mobile', width: 375, height: 800 },
]

async function goTo(page: Page, label: string) {
  const target = Date.parse('1 ' + label)
  const label$ = page.getByTestId('month-label')
  for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) {
    const cur = await label$.innerText()
    if (cur === label) return
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: Date.parse('1 ' + cur) > target ? 'Previous month' : 'Next month' }).click()
  }
  throw new Error('could not reach ' + label)
}

async function add(page: Page, o: { type?: 'income' | 'expense'; amount: string; cat?: string; date: string; note: string; repeat?: boolean }) {
  const form = page.getByRole('form', { name: 'Add transaction' })
  if (o.type) await form.getByText(o.type, { exact: true }).click()
  await form.getByLabel('Amount').fill(o.amount)
  if (o.cat) await form.getByLabel('Category').selectOption({ label: o.cat })
  await form.getByLabel('Date').fill(o.date)
  await form.getByLabel(/Note/).fill(o.note)
  if (o.repeat) await form.getByLabel('Repeat monthly').check()
  await form.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add transaction' }).click()
}

const row = (page: Page, text: string) => page.getByTestId('tx-row').filter({ hasText: text })

      await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.clear())

      await add(page, { amount: '100', cat: 'Housing', date: '2026-01-31', note: 'Rent', repeat: true })

      await expect(row(page, 'One-off').getByTestId('recurring-badge')).toHaveCount(0)

      // Appears in later months on the same day, clamped to the last day

  const label$ = page.getByTestId('month-label')
  for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) {
    const cur = await label$.innerText()
    if (cur === label) return
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: Date.parse('1 ' + cur) > target ? 'Previous month' : 'Next month' }).click()
  }
  throw new Error('could not reach ' + label)
}

  const form = page.getByRole('form', { name: 'Add transaction' })
  if (o.type) await form.getByText(o.type, { exact: true }).click()
  await form.getByLabel('Amount').fill(o.amount)
  if (o.cat) await form.getByLabel('Category').selectOption({ label: o.cat })
  await form.getByLabel('Date').fill(o.date)
  await form.getByLabel(/Note/).fill(o.note)
  if (o.repeat) await form.getByLabel('Repeat monthly').check()
  await form.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add transaction' }).click()

Repeating monthly transactions now work at 1280px and 375px, and all tests pass: 38 logic tests and 4 browser tests. Nothing is committed.

**How it behaves**
- **Marking one as repeating:** the add and edit forms have a "Repeat monthly" checkbox. Repeating rows show a "↻ Monthly" badge.
- **Later months:** a repeating transaction is created in a later month the first time you open that month, on the same day. A 31st becomes the 30th, 28th or 29th in shorter months, and goes back to the 31st when the month allows. Reopening a month, switching back and forth, or reloading never duplicates it. A repeating transaction doesn't appear in months before the one it started in.
- **Recurring screen:** a new "Recurring" tab lists every repeating transaction, with its category, note, amount, day, start month and status. "Stop repeating…" lets you pick a "Stop from" month. Months before it stay unchanged; that month and later ones lose the transaction. Stopped ones stay listed as "Stopped from May 2026".

**Choices I made where you didn't say**
- **Editing a repeating transaction:** the change applies to that month and later months, but not earlier ones. I first built it so only months opened after the edit changed. That meant months you had merely scrolled past kept the old amount, so I changed it.
- **Unticking the checkbox when editing:** the repeat stops after that month, and later occurrences are removed.
- **Deleting one occurrence:** it stays deleted. Reopening that month doesn't bring it back, and the rest of the series continues.
- **Deleting the original transaction:** the repeat keeps going. You stop it from the Recurring screen.
- **Stop-from options:** they run from the month after the start up to 24 months ahead. You can't stop a rule from its own start month.

**What I tested**
- **Logic tests** (`npm test`, 38 tests, 25 of them new in `src/lib/recurring.test.ts`):
  - Day clamping, including leap years and the 31st → 30th/28th/29th → 31st round trip.
  - Idempotent creation, skipping ahead and backfilling skipped months, and deleted occurrences staying deleted.
  - Stopping removes the stop month and later ones, keeps earlier ones, and leaves other repeats and one-off transactions alone.
  - The edit rules: starting, changing later months, keeping earlier ones and hand-changed ones, moving the day, moving to another month without duplicates, and unticking.
  - Save/load round trip, old saved data without repeats, and broken repeat entries being ignored.
- **Browser walkthrough** (`e2e/recurring.spec.ts`, real Chrome at 1280px and 375px):
  - Jan 31 → Feb 28 → Mar 31 → Apr 30, with one row per month after switching back and forth and after a reload.
  - A repeating income landing on Feb 29, 2028.
  - Editing a repeating transaction (checkbox ticked, later months follow, January stays at $100).
  - Recurring screen: stop with Cancel first, then stop from May 2026; Jan–Apr stay, May onward are gone, and the stopped status survives a reload.
  - Ticking repeat on a plain transaction, then unticking it later.
  - Deleting one occurrence and reopening its month, and a CSV export that includes generated rows.
  - No horizontal scroll on the Recurring screen, and no JavaScript errors.
- **Existing walkthrough:** the earlier `e2e/budget.spec.ts` still passes at both sizes.
- **Screenshots:** I looked at the Recurring screen with the stop panel open, and at the Overview with the new checkbox, at both sizes.

The tests did turn up one design problem (the "months you scrolled past" issue above). The other two failures were outdated expectations in my own tests.
